key_factors.impact_cn: 仅在90分钟打平后评估加时；入口以1-1为主、0-0次之。加时30分钟且淘汰赛风险偏好下降，西班牙与比利时更可能谨慎管理，0-0仍平是基础高概率分支。
key_factors.impact_en: Extra time is evaluated only if the match is level after 90 minutes; the entry path is mainly 1-1, followed by 0-0. With only 30 minutes and lower knockout risk appetite, Spain and Belgium are more likely to manage the period cautiously, making 0-0 in extra time the base high-probability branch.

key_factors.impact_cn: 西班牙在加时仍有控场、防守稳定和Rodri/Pedri中路节奏优势，可争取二点与节奏主动；但进入加时已说明90分钟优势未兑现，不能外推成碾压。
key_factors.impact_en: Spain can still lean on control, defensive stability and Rodri/Pedri central tempo in extra time, winning second balls and dictating rhythm. But reaching extra time already means the 90-minute edge did not fully convert, so it should not be framed as domination.

key_factors.impact_cn: 西班牙的单点破局路径包括Yamal对De Cuyper一侧制造高质量机会；关键在于加时是否仍有速度优势，或比利时是否已通过换人、协防完成限制。
key_factors.impact_en: Spain’s one-v-one breakthrough path includes Yamal creating high-quality chances against De Cuyper’s side. The key question is whether that pace edge remains in extra time or Belgium has already adjusted through substitutions and cover.

key_factors.impact_en: Belgium’s survival path comes from Doku transitions, Lukaku as a target, De Bruyne’s final pass, Tielemans arriving late and substitute impact. One successful transition or set piece can create a one-goal extra-time win branch.

key_factors.impact_en: De Bruyne and Lukaku’s actual starting status, available minutes and post-90 fitness remain key uncertainties; there is not enough reliable evidence to confirm whether they can keep providing high-quality attack in extra time.

key_factors.impact_cn: 若105分钟后仍平，点球分支应向接近五五收缩；目前缺少西班牙点球主罚顺序与近期主罚状态，也无法确认其点球深度是否优于比利时。
key_factors.impact_en: If it is still level after 105 minutes, the penalty branch should compress toward nearly even. Spain’s penalty order and recent taker form are not clearly confirmed, and it is not possible to verify a clear penalty-depth edge over Belgium.
